subject: Three sessions, one review
question: What changed, what is risky, and which open items need your call?
summary: Research, build and host-test sessions from today. Pick one option per open item and press Copy or Send.
source: examples/sessions/1-research.log, 2-build.log and 3-hosts.log, three session logs from building this skill on 2026-10-25, trimmed of internal planning notes. An agent wrote this JSON from them.

items.title: Call notes cleaned and research written
items.detail: Wrote 00-cleaned-notes.md, 01-analysis.md, research-1..4 and the build brief.

items.title: Decided: five fixed shapes, the pick returns to the agent
items.detail: Zero dependencies; a question that fits no shape gets prose.

items.title: Decided: Intelligent UI Anything first, Connect Anything second
items.detail: Both to be tested together on 2026-10-26.

items.title: Skill built in two commits
items.detail: `78cba8b` core: five shape templates, one theme, render, check and serve. `7702a13` references, tests, CI, plugin manifests and two sourced examples.

items.title: Hallmark sloplint vendored
items.detail: Upstream commit `7ec8682` (MIT), blob identical to upstream.

items.title: Checks green
items.detail: `node tests/run` 20 of 20 pass; `scripts/check --templates` 5 of 5 pass with 0 lint findings; skills-ref validate passes; claude plugin validate passes with one warning (no icon).

items.title: Host detection now checks Codex before Claude Code
items.detail: Codex started from Claude Code inherits `CLAUDECODE=1`, so Codex markers (`CODEX_SANDBOX`, `CODEX_CI`) are checked first.

items.title: Codex and Linux paths measured
items.detail: In `codex exec`, `open probe.html` fails in the sandbox (exit 1). In Docker Linux, headless prints the path, `xdg-open` with no browser exits 3, and SSH serves on 127.0.0.1 with an `ssh -L` line.

items.title: Colima restarted
items.detail: Its Docker socket had been dead since 2026-09-23. Machine state, not repo state.

items.title: Copy button in a claude.ai artifact may be blocked
items.detail: The viewer's sandbox may block clipboard access. Not tested. Copy is the fallback for returning a pick, so this matters there.

items.title: Local server stops after 30 idle minutes
items.detail: A user who reads longer loses Send and must use Copy. If Copy is also blocked somewhere, the pick has no way back.

items.title: Cursor and Antigravity markers unverified
items.detail: Neither is installed; detection there is untested and falls back to defaults.

items.title: How much to test the skill description?
items.detail: The full skill-creator loop is about 300 `claude -p` runs; the other option is a two-round check.
